notes.title: New Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience with the launch crashes some people were experiencing. 
We are grateful for your feedback which enabled us to get the fixes done asap.

Below you will find the patch notes for the two fixes. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38151690/327e2d59823591bad3e6a22146e3be84127b7f5e.png[/img]

If you have any questions you can reach us on our social media channels linked below. 

Facebook: https://facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ

Alternatively you can [url=https://discord.gg/aCHvcc7SjN]join our Discord server[/url], we'd love to have you there.

Thanks for your ongoing support!

[i]Piccolo Studio and Untold Tales[/i]
